Featured Notifications Check Let\'s verify if your system is configured correctly to display Hyper Bridge islands. Not Supported Enabled Open System Settings Why is this not an island? Your Xiaomi device intercepted the notification but failed to display it as a featured island because the permission is disabled in your system settings.\n\nTo fix this:\n1. Tap "Open System Settings"\n2. Scroll down to "Featured Notifications" (or similar)\n3. Enable it for Hyper Bridge. Alternative: Shizuku Override If your system doesn\'t show the setting or it\'s restricted, you can bypass the Xiaomi whitelist entirely by setting up Shizuku. Hyper Bridge will use Shizuku to post islands directly.

Floating notification setup Avoid duplicate native banners for selected apps HyperBridge displays selected incoming notifications in the Island. The source app still owns sound, vibration, and its notification-center entry. To prevent duplicate heads-up popups, open each app’s system notification settings, disable its native floating notification, and confirm it below. Prefer native floating notifications? You can keep native floating notifications enabled on your apps and instead turn off Heads-up Popup (Notificación Emergente) in HyperBridge Global Settings to avoid duplicate banners. No bridged apps Select apps from the Library first. This setup remains available later.
